usedFor: Clientary holds clients, invoices and leads, and Calendly returns a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link” when “New Client” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Clientary, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new client is the right time to offer a meeting, and the action creates a booking link for it.

watchOut: “New Client” in Clientary is polling, so the link appears after a scheduled check, not instantly.
